Synopsis:
    Sterling softened marginally against a stronger dollar, pressured by a global bond selloff, rising gilt yields (10-year hitting 16-year highs at 5.25%), and hawkish Fed signals from Powell. Key UK-specific drivers include fiscal uncertainty ahead of PM Andy Burnham's October budget, elevated energy prices feeding inflation concerns, and mixed UK economic data. The BoE is expected to hold at 3.75%, though markets price in one more hike by year-end.
